description: He who wills goodness and mercy for all His creatures
meaningAr: صاحب الرحمة الواسعة الشاملة التي وسعت الخلائق كلهم، وهي رحمة ذاتية ثابتة له في أزله، شملت المؤمن والكافر والجماد والحيوان بمداد الوجود والرزق.

description: He who acts with extreme kindness
meaningAr: الذي يوصل رحمته إلى عباده المؤمنين خاصة في الدنيا بالهداية وفي الآخرة بالجنة، فهو اسم يدل على الفعل والإنعام الموجه للمخلصين.

description: The Sovereign Lord, The One with the complete Dominion, the One Whose Dominion is clear from imperfection
meaningAr: المالك الحقيقي لكل شيء، المتصرف في الأكوان بأمره ونهيه، الذي لا يحتاج إلى أعوان، وكل مَن سواه عبد خاضع لسطانه.

description: The One who is pure from any imperfection and clear from children and adversaries
meaningAr: المنزه عن كل نقص يلحق بالمخلوقين، المطهر عن الأنداد والأشباه، الذي تقدست ذاته عن الخيال والأوهام.

description: The one who provides peace, calm and serenity. By citing this name, we declare peace for ourselves and for those around us.
meaningAr: الذي سلمت ذاته من العيوب، وصفاته من النقص، وأفعاله من الشر، وهو واهب السلام والأمان لجميع خلقه في الدارين.

description: This name is mysterious even for Muslims because "Al-Mu'min" comes from the name "Al-iman" which means to believe, from where comes the name "Al-Mu'minoune" which means believers, it is is the name of the Quran for people who believe in 6 things: the oneness of God, the existence of angels, holy books (Torah, Gospel and Psalms (Zabor) unmodified and the Quran), the prophets, the last day (the day of judgment) and fate its evil and its good. The exact meaning of this name is very difficult to pin down in its original meaning but can be understood from a deeper and more mystical point of view.
meaningAr: المصدق لرسله بإظهار المعجزات، الوافي بعهده لعباده، الذي آمن خلقه من الظلم، ووهب قلوب أوليائه التصديق واليقين.

description: Whoever dominates His creation and by His omnipotence in all aspects, no state or aspect in this world or the other escapes His will.
meaningAr: الرقيب الحافظ لكل شيء، القائم على خلقه بأعمالهم وأرزاقهم وآجالهم، المستولي بعلمه وقدرته على خفايا الأمور.

description: The Glorious by His supremacy and His greatness, El-Aziz means in a sense the one who is dear and precious in the eyes of His creatures. He is not the servant of any creature, and no creature dictates to him what to do.
meaningAr: القوي الغالب الذي لا يُنال شأنه، المنيع الذي لا يُغلب، وهو مصدر كل عزة في الوجود، فمن اعتز بغيره ذل.

description: The grandiose, the ultimate powerful by His greatness and His unlimited strength. When He destroys the oppressors (unjust and sinners) He applies His sentence with righteousness.
meaningAr: الذي يجبر كسر القلوب والنفوس، ويُصلح أحوال العباد بلطفه، وهو أيضاً القاهر الذي تنفذ مشيئته في كل أحد ولا تنفذ فيه مشيئة أحد.

description: He who is superior to His creatures, no creature has the right to claim greatness.
meaningAr: الذي له الكبرياء والعظمة، المتعالي عن صفات الخلق وعن كل سوء، المنفرد برداء العظمة الذي لا يليق بغيره.

description: The Creator of all existences, living or dead, mobile or frozen.
meaningAr: الموجد للأشياء من العدم على مقتضى علمه وتقديره، المبدع في تصوير الأصول وتكوين الذوات قبل وجودها.

description: He who lifts His creation above all faults or imperfections.
meaningAr: الذي خلق الخلق بغير تفاوت، وأبرزهم من العدم إلى الوجود بتميز وتناسق، والمنزه عن الخلل في صنعه.

description: The one who gives the look and the appearance to each creation from the inside as well as from the outside. In lost Arabic, literally, this word means sculptor and, in modern Arabic, literally means designer.
meaningAr: الذي أعطى لكل مخلوق ملامحه الخاصة وصورته الفريدة، وزينه بما يناسب وظيفته في الوجود.

description: Is the One who forgives what He wants to whom He wants.
meaningAr: الذي يستر القبيح ويُظهر الجميل، كثير المغفرة الذي يعود بالستر على عباده مرة بعد مرة مهما تكرر الذنب.

description: Is the One who is almighty to submit all creation to His will.
meaningAr: الذي قهر الجبابرة بسلطانه، وقهر الأرواح بالموت، الغالب الذي خضعت له الرقاب وذلت له الصعاب.

description: Is the One who gives immensely without receiving anything in return
meaningAr: كثير العطايا والمنن، الذي يعطي بلا سؤال وبلا غرض، ويهب لمن يشاء ما يشاء من غير استحقاق مسبق.

description: Is the One who makes distribute to every creature what it needs.
meaningAr: المتكفل بإيصال الأقوات المادية للصور، والأقوات المعنوية (العلوم والإيمان) للقلوب، الذي وسع رزقه البر والفاجر.

description: Is He Who alone knows the keys to the future and the unknown, by His knowledge and by His wisdom. This name is often associated with the following name "Al-‘Alīm".
meaningAr: الذي يفتح بعلمه منغلق الأمور، وبقدرته أبواب الخير، وبحكمته بصائر العباد، وهو الحكم الذي يفصل بين الحق والباطل.

description: The one from whom nothing can hide, for He knows everything and is aware of everything.
meaningAr: الذي لا يخفى عليه مثقال ذرة، المحيط بما كان وما يكون وما لم يكن لو كان كيف يكون، علمه لا يسبقه جهل ولا يلحقه نسيان.

description: Is the One who restricts His good according to wisdom.
meaningAr: الذي يضيق الأرزاق والنفوس بحكمته، ويقبض الأرواح عند آجالها، ويقبض القلوب لتستشعر عظمة جلاله.

description: Is the One who frees, increases and multiplies his good according to wisdom.
meaningAr: الذي يوسع الأرزاق برحمته، ويبسط النفوس بالأمل والسرور، ويمد يده بالتوبة للمذنبين.

description: Is the One who destines the oppressors and the proud to demeanor and chastisement.
meaningAr: الذي يخفض أهل الباطل ويذل الجبارين، ويخفض قدر كل من استكبر عن أمره وابتعد عن طاعته.

description: The Breeder in the sense of raising, the one who elevates the honor, the status and the prestige of a being in this lower world and in the hereafter.
meaningAr: الذي يرفع أولياءه بالنصر، والعلماء بالعلم، والمؤمنين بالدرجات في الجنان، ويرفع ذكر من أطاعه.

description: One who offers honor and precious value.
meaningAr: الذي يهب العزة والمنعة لمن يشاء، فيجعل العبد عزيزاً بدينه ويقينه وسلطانه الصالح.

description: Is the One who can humiliate and devalue any valiant.
meaningAr: الذي يذل من يشاء بسلب العز عنه وتسليط الهوان عليه لطرده من رحمته أو لكسر جبروته.

description: One who hears any noise or sound in His kingdom emanating from any creature and also One who listens to the invocations of His creatures to respond to their invocations.
meaningAr: الذي يسمع السر والنجوى، ولا يشغله سمع عن سمع، يسمع دعاء الداعين، وتسبيح الكائنات بجميع اللغات.

description: Is the One from whom nothing that exists or comes into existence can escape without the slightest use of an eye, instrument or organ.
meaningAr: الذي يرى خفايا الأمور، ويبصر دبيب النملة السوداء على الصخرة الصماء في الليلة الظلماء، مطلع على أحوال القلوب.

description: He is the One who judges and decides between creatures here below and in the hereafter and He who ensures equity between the creatures and no one else will and will not be able to decide between them and judge them; and the Judgment in the hereafter will be perfectly just and appropriate.
meaningAr: صاحب الحكم الذي لا يُرد، الذي يفصل بين الخلق بالحق، وحكمه هو العدل المحض في الدنيا والآخرة.

description: Is the One who is free from all forms of injustice and / or oppression.
meaningAr: المنزه عن الجور في أفعاله وأحكامه، الذي يعطي كل ذي حق حقه، وتصرفه في ملكه كله عدل.

description: Is the One who grants his creatures His gentleness and His benevolence.
meaningAr: الرفيق بعباده الذي يوصل إليهم مصالحهم بلطف من حيث لا يحتسبون، والعالم بخفايا ودقائق الأمور.

description: He is the One from whom cannot be hidden the reality of everything that exists, that is to say the truth of things; no detail escapes Him, neither the thing as a whole, nor each of its parts; and to claim to be able to hide things from the One who creates everything is a delusion and a disbelief.
meaningAr: المحيط ببواطن الأشياء كما أحاط بظواهرها، مطلع على النوايا والضمائر وما تكنّه الصدور.

description: Is the One whose patience towards the disbeliefs of sinners exceeds all imagination (it is possible that forgiveness will be granted to them).
meaningAr: الذي يرى معصية العاصين ولا يستفزه الغضب، بل يمهلهم للتوبة مع قدرته على العقاب الفوري.

description: This name is difficult to translate because it includes several English words that do not share the same spiritual meaning, but it can be approached as follows: "Al-Adhīm" He who is Gigantic Majestic and Fantastically Grandiose far from any bodily or material imperfection
meaningAr: المنفرد بكل معاني الجلال، الذي تجاوزت عظمته حدود العقل، ولا يحيط بكنه ذاته أحد.

description: Is the One who forgives immensely over and over again.
meaningAr: الساتر لذنوب عباده المتجاوز عن خطاياهم مهما تكررت وعظمت، واسع المغفرة والصفح.

description: Is the One who shows His gratitude for worshipers, however incredibly easy to perform.
meaningAr: الذي ينمي القليل من أعمال العباد ويضاعف أجرها، ويقابل الشكر بالزيادة من النعم.

description: Is the One who is above all that He created perfectly and unimaginably.
meaningAr: الذي له العلو المطلق ذاتا وقدراً وقهراً، فوق كل شيء، ولا يُعلى عليه أبداً.

description: The Great: One who is greater than His creation, a greatness that only He knows.
meaningAr: العظيم الذي صغر كل شيء أمام كبريائه، ذو الكبرياء والجلال التي لا تُحيط بها العقول.

description: Is the One who protects and preserves His good.
meaningAr: الحافظ لجميع المخلوقات، الذي يحفظ المؤمن من الفتن والشرور، ويحفظ أعمال العباد ليجزي عليها.

description: this word is among the lost words of the ancient Arabic language; very difficult to translate even in modern Arabic. It would mean: Is the One who leaves no detail when He judges, even the most trivial.
meaningAr: المقتدر الذي يخلق الأقوات ويوصلها للأبدان والقلوب، الحفيظ القائم على كل نفس بما تقتات به.

description: He is the One who will count all the facts of His creatures without forgetting or error.
meaningAr: الكافي الذي يكفي عباده ما أهمهم، والمحاسب الذي يحصي أعمال الخلائق بدقة متناهية.

description: Is the One who is perfectly exempt from being compared to His creatures or from being like Him.
meaningAr: صاحب صفات الكمال والجلال والعظمة، الذي يستحق أن يُهاب ويُعظم لذاته.

meaning: The Most Generous, The Most Esteemed
description: Is the One who flooded His creation with His generosity.
meaningAr: كثير الخير الجواد الذي يعطي من غير سؤال، ويصفح عن الخطايا، ويفي بالعهود.

description: Is the One who observes and beholds all that He has created (and the actions of creatures are also creations).
meaningAr: المطلع على الضمائر، المراقب لحركات الخلق وسكناتهم، لا يغيب عن نظره شيء.

description: Is the One who answers the invocations of His creatures if He wills and to whom He wills.
meaningAr: الذي يقابل السؤال بالعطاء، والدعاء بالإجابة، والاضطرار بالإغاثة، قريب من عباده.

description: This name in Arabic means: immensely wide, but to qualify God it is understood that He has filled every void and has contained all things in a way that only He knows.
meaningAr: الذي لا تضيق عليه رحمة ولا رزق، وسع كرسيه السماوات والأرض، محيط بكل شيء.

description: He whose Wisdom has dazzled, dazzled and will dazzle any conscious and intelligent mind.
meaningAr: المقدّر للأشياء بحكمة بالغة، يضع كل شيء في موضعه الصحيح، لا يعرض لفعله خلل.

description: This word in Arabic means: The one who draws near to his beloved by mercy, pity and beneficence, but when one reads this name in the "Quran", one feels each time different meanings which are difficult to translate into words. We can try to translate it: The one who draws near to His servants out of pity although they move away from Him and do not glorify Him.
meaningAr: المحب لأوليائه المحبوب في قلوبهم، الذي يتودد إلى عباده بالنعم والمغفرة.

meaning: The Glorious One, The Most Honorable
description: Is the One who is glorified in the infinitely past, present and eternal.
meaningAr: الشريف بذاته، العظيم بأفعاله، واسع الكرم والفضل، ذو المجد والكمال.

description: Is the One who raises the dead and deploys life in whatever He wants, be they men, animals or simply earth.
meaningAr: محيي الموتى للحساب، وباعث الرسل للهداية، وباعث العزيمة في قلوب العباد.

description: The Witness, the One from whom nothing is absent.
meaningAr: الحاضر الذي لا يغيب عنه غائب، المطلع على الحقائق، الذي يشهد على كل نفس بما كسبت.

description: Is the One who holds the absolute Truth.
meaningAr: الموجود حقاً، الذي لا يزول ولا يتغير، كلامه حق، ولقاؤه حق، ووعده حق.

description: Is the One who guarantees the sustenance of creatures and the One from whom nothing of their every state can be concealed
meaningAr: الكفيل بتدبير أمور عباده، الذي يُعتمد عليه في كل شأن، القائم بمصالح خلقه.

description: The Mighty: Allah is the most powerful, the strongest, his strength has no limit and is not described with definitions of physical strength.
meaningAr: صاحب القدرة الكاملة التي لا يعتريها ضعف، الغالب الذي لا يُقهر.

description: The Enduring: An endurance worthy of Him, unlimited, indefatigable, and which is not marred by any weakness, without pause, without interruption and which no factor can attenuate.
meaningAr: شديد القوة والصلابة، الذي لا تنقطع قوته ولا يلحقه تعب أو لغوب.

description: Is the One who preserves the believing servants, so the prophets and those who follow them are those who are the "preserved people" in the sense that they have been guided to the obligatory thanks to Him who makes them exist, that is, that is to say with regard to Allah
meaningAr: الناصر والمحب لأوليائه، المتولي لأمورهم بالحفظ والتدبير واللطف.

description: Is the One who deserves the thanksgiving, the glorification and the song of praise more than any other
meaningAr: المستحق للحمد والثناء بجميل صفاته وعظيم آلائه، المحمود في الرخاء والشدة.

description: Literally translated as the counter but means the One who counts every creature, every act, every speck of dust in his kingdom and of whom nothing escapes his knowledge
meaningAr: الذي أحصى كل شيء عدداً وعلمه بعلمه المحيط، فلا تغيب عنه مثقال ذرة.

description: Is the One who gives a beginning to what does not exist without a beginning, without a model, that is to say, the One who creates creatures
meaningAr: الذي بدأ الخلق وأوجده من العدم، مصدر كل بداية في هذا الوجود.

description: Is the One who brings the living back to death after life and the One who brings the dead back to life after death
meaningAr: الذي يعيد الخلق بعد فنائه، ويرد الأشياء إلى حالتها الأولى بقدرته.

description: Is the One who gives life to a mixture of maniyy, that is to say of seminal liquid, devoid of soul and makes him a living being and the One who gives life to the bodies of humans, jinns and angels by reuniting them with their souls during the resurrection
meaningAr: الذي يحيي الأجساد والقلوب، ويبث الروح في كل حي بكلمة (كن).

description: He is the One who kills living beings and the One who cancels out the power of the powerful of this world by death
meaningAr: الذي يكتب الموت على الأحياء، القابض للأرواح بحكمته عند انقضاء الأجل.

description: The Living One: Is the One who does not come into existence and yet exists, and the One who possesses a hayah and this attribute is not a life as is the hayah of creatures made up of a combination of soul, flesh and of blood Imam At-Tahawiyy said in his treatise on belief that "he who attributes to Allah an attribute in a sense which is among those which can be attributed to human beings is disbeliever"
meaningAr: الدائم البقاء الذي لا يموت، المتصف بالحياة الكاملة أزلاً وأبداً.

description: Is the One who exists, is eternal and does not change and the One who is not affected by non-existence or annihilation and is in no way affected by controlling and creating the acts of human beings
meaningAr: القائم بنفسه المستغني عن خلقه، القائم بتدبير وحفظ كل موجود في هذا الكون.

description: Is the One who does not need anything and is not reached or concerned with want, lack or need
meaningAr: الغني الذي لا يفتقر أبداً، الواجد لكل ما يريد، المحيط بكل شيء.

description: Is the One who is better than any other and the One who bestows innumerable benefits very widely and without compensation
meaningAr: كثير الجود والشرف، الذي له الكمال المطلق في الذات والصفات.

description: The Unique: Is the One who has no alter ego, whether in His Being, in His Act, or in His Attributes. Nothing is like him
meaningAr: المنفرد بذاته، الذي لا شريك له، ولا يشبهه شيء في صفاته أو أفعاله.

description: The One: Is He Who has uniqueness as an attribute
meaningAr: الفرد الذي لم يلد ولم يولد، المنفرد بالصمدية، الغاية في الوحدانية.

description: Is the One to whom we can rely for any business and who can be called upon for all our needs; One who has no children or parents, neither like nor equivalent, according to Al-Hakim's explanation; The One who needs nothing and the One who everything needs, in order to exist, etc.
meaningAr: السيد المقصود في الحوائج، الذي تصمد إليه الخلائق في رغائبها، الغني عما سواه.

description: Is the One who is unaffected by weakness, the One whose power is absolute and dominates all creatures and the One whom absolutely nothing can weaken
meaningAr: الذي يقدر على ما يريد، لا يعجزه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء، قادر على نصرة أوليائه.

description: Is the One who is mighty over all things and the One whose capacities are absolutely limitless
meaningAr: التام القدرة الذي لا يمتنع عليه شيء، المقدّر للأمور بحكمته وقوته المطلقة.

description: Is He who is free from the characteristics of creatures and better than any creature; He who fixes the speed of events, accelerates certain things in the eyes of people according to a destiny and grants each thing a value, a rank, a time and characteristics which suit Him according to wisdom
meaningAr: الذي يقدم الأشياء ويضعها في مراتبها بحكمته، يقدم المؤمنين بالهداية والطاعة.

description: Is He who is free from the characteristics of creatures and better than any creature; The one who intends the slowness of events and slows down certain things in the eyes of people according to a destiny and grants each thing a value, a rank, a time and characteristics which suit it according to a wisdom (cf no 71)
meaningAr: الذي يؤخر ما يشاء من الأمور والخلائق لحكمة خفية، يؤخر العقاب لمن يرجو توبته.

description: The First: Is the One who exists without creatures, without beginning and without time; One who is exempt from being created, from the appearance of a new attribute and from change, One who exists without coming into existence
meaningAr: السابق لكل موجود، الذي ليس قبله شيء، منه تبدأ كل الخيرات.

description: The Last: Is the One who exists without interruption while the creatures are annihilated at every moment; He who is eternal, He who annihilates and is exempt from being annihilated and the disappearance of one or more attributes; The one that exists without being concerned by the notion of end and annihilation
meaningAr: الباقي بعد فناء كل شيء، الذي إليه المرجع والمنتهى، غاية كل مقصود.

description: Is the One whose existence is manifested in everything by proofs, from the point of view of power and domination and not what would be present in any body from the point of view of place, image and how
meaningAr: البين وجوده بالآفاق، الغالب العالي فوق كل شيء، الظاهر بآياته الباهرة.

description: Is the One who is preserved from the delusions of creatures attempting to attribute to the Creator human characteristics or characteristics of creatures and the One who creates the characteristics of creatures and their images
meaningAr: المحتجب عن الأوهام، القريب بعلمه من كل خفي، المطلع على أسرار الغيوب.

description: Is the One who owns, manages and controls all things and the One who creates everything according to wisdom
meaningAr: المنفرد بالتدبير، المتصرف في الأشياء بمشيئته، القائم على إدارة شؤون الكون.

description: Is the One who is free from the attributes of creatures and the One whose power over creatures is boundless
meaningAr: المستعلي على كل شيء بقدرته، المنزه عن صفات المخلوقين، ذو العلو المطلق.

description: Is the One who has the ability to bestow faith and blessings on all creatures, and among them some are grateful and some are not: the former are called Muslims or believers and others are called non-Muslims or non-Muslims. -believers
meaningAr: المحسن العطوف، كثير الخير والبر بعباده، الصادق في وعده الذي يعطي أكثر مما يُطلب.

description: Is the One who grants forgiveness to those who repent every time they repent
meaningAr: الذي ييسر سبل التوبة لعباده، ويقبلها منهم مرة بعد أخرى بفضله وكرمه.

description: Is the avenger
meaningAr: الذي يقصم الجبارين، ويجازي العصاة بعدله بعد الإعذار والإنذار، الغالب بقهره.

description: Is the One who sets aside and forgives sin and the One who preserves in every seemingly hopeless situation a door to honor, maintenance and blessings or to immediate repentance
meaningAr: الذي يمحو أثر الذنب بالكلية، المتجاوز عن السيئات كأنها لم تكن، صفحة واسع.

description: Is the One who can offer an immensity of benefits without counterpart and without necessity
meaningAr: شديد الرحمة والرأفة، الذي يرق لحال عباده ويخفف عنهم الأعباء بلطفه.

description: Is the One who creates and attributes according to a destiny all sovereignty, domination, property and all broad power which are granted to certain creatures in this lower world
meaningAr: المتصرف في الوجود كله، بيده مقاليد السماوات والأرض، يعطي الملك من يشاء.

description: That is, Allah is the One who is better than any other in reality and all the evidence confirms this and denies the contrary so it is not valid to dispute this point, to deny it or to be hostile against this subject; is the One who fills with blessings those who will have understood this who will know the general holiness, will have success and will be well guided on the Day of Judgment
meaningAr: المستحق للتعظيم لجلاله، والمحبوب لإنعامه وإكرامه، ذو الكمال المطلق.

description: Is the One who judges according to the greatest justice, the One who is free from all forms of injustice and tyranny, and the One who has absolutely no accountability
meaningAr: العادل في حكمه، الذي ينصف المظلوم ويؤدي لكل ذي حق حقه بتمام العدل.

description: Is the One who gathers creatures together on a day of which there is no doubt, the Day of Judgment
meaningAr: جامع الخلائق ليوم لا ريب فيه، وجامع الحقائق، وجامع قلوب العباد على ما يشاء.

description: Is the One who has no need of creatures and whose creatures cannot do without al-Ghaniyy [who is the One who makes them exist and keeps them in existence and constantly changes them]
meaningAr: الذي لا يفتقر لشيء، وكل ما سواه محتاج إليه، واسع الغنى والمغفرة.

description: Is the One who satisfies the needs of creatures and the One who brings them their sustenance
meaningAr: الذي يسوق الغنى لعباده، ويغني القلوب بالإيمان، والأيدي بالرزق الحلال.

description: Is the One who intends for each creature his victories, his protections and the One from whom they must always be preserved according to a destiny
meaningAr: الذي يمنع بفضله من يشاء عما يشاء، حماية لأوليائه أو ابتلاءً بحكمته.

description: Is the One who is almighty to bring inevitably the nuisance which must reach a creature according to a destiny
meaningAr: الذي يقدر الضر ليختبر الصبر، ولا يقع ضر إلا بإرادته لغاية حكمية.

description: Is the One who is almighty to bring inevitably the profit that a creature must receive according to a destiny
meaningAr: مصدر كل نفع وخير في الوجود، الذي ينفع من يشاء بفضله الواسع.

description: The Light: Is the One who guides to their goal those who are prey to temptation and puts them in the right direction according to a destiny; Allah is the One who guides believers to the light of faith, creates light and is not a light that is only a creature
meaningAr: المنور للسماوات والأرض، هادي القلوب لنوره، مظهر الأشياء بوجوده.

description: Is the One who intends for certain creatures the benefit of being well guided and of knowing righteousness
meaningAr: المرشد للضالين، الذي يهدي العباد لمصالحهم الدنيوية والدينية بلطفه.

description: Is the One who brings creatures and this world into existence, not from pre-existing matter or in the image of an earlier model, but on the contrary without precursor, model and unprecedented
meaningAr: الموجد للأشياء على غير مثال سابق، الغاية في الجمال والإبداع.

description: Is the One whose existence free from annihilation and change is imposed on sound reason which cannot claim the contrary
meaningAr: الدائم الذي لا ينتهي وجوده، المستمر بلا انقطاع، الحي بعد فناء الخلق.

description: Is the One who exists and does not change as creatures are wiped out
meaningAr: الذي يرث الأرض ومن عليها، الباقي بعد رحيل كل ملك ومالك.

description: Is the One who guides creatures to what is in their best interests
meaningAr: الذي يسوق الخلائق إلى مصالحهم بحكمته، المرشد للصواب بلا وسيط.

description: Is the One who delays the punishment of sinners by adjusting the accounts of each until a definite day and gives them their ease and time until a time of which they all do not know the date.
meaningAr: الذي لا يعاجل بالعقوبة، الذي يمهل عباده، وصبور على أذاهم وجحودهم.
